title: Removes coupon and promotion code parameters with stackable discounts
changed: coupon and promotion_code request parameters removed from subscriptions.create/update and customers.create/update
coupon request parameter removed from invoices.createPreview
reason: Not mapped: the adapter names POST /v1/invoices/create_preview `invoices.createPreview.create` from its URL (stripe-operations.ts stripeContractOperations, stripe-benchmark.ts stripeOperations), but stripe-node calls it `invoices.createPreview`, so the call is not traced and no finding names it. (Under fullDiff, oasdiff can still report the operation's change when another mapped call returns the same object, which stops the whole run without naming this call.)

changed: coupon and promotion_code request parameters removed from subscriptions.create/update and customers.create/update
parts.reason: removedRequestParameters (request-removals.ts) finds the removed top-level body parameter on the mapped operation; analyzeRepository marks each traced call that still sends it with requestParameter, and migrationReviewReason (migration-review.ts) stops automatic migration, AI and publication with REMOVED_REQUEST_PARAMETER_REVIEW_REASON. REMOVED_PARAMETER_NOTES.coupon and promotion_code tell the reviewer that a populated discounts array overwrites every discount on a subscription update.

changed: coupon request parameter removed from invoices.createPreview
parts.reason: Not mapped: the adapter names POST /v1/invoices/create_preview `invoices.createPreview.create` from its URL (stripe-operations.ts stripeContractOperations, stripe-benchmark.ts stripeOperations), but stripe-node calls it `invoices.createPreview`, so the call is not traced and no finding names it. (Under fullDiff, oasdiff can still report the operation's change when another mapped call returns the same object, which stops the whole run without naming this call.)

Only with fullDiff (oasdiff; the watch worker default, off in `refit run` and in the benchmark fix stage): compareOpenApi (openapi-diff.ts) reports the request change and findBreakingOperationImpacts (provider-operations.ts) lists every traced call of that operation as an operation impact, which blocks AI and stops the run in scanReviewReason (workflow.ts), whether or not the call sends the changed value. Without fullDiff Refit reports nothing.

parts.how: findRemovedProperties (specifications.ts) reports the removed field and analyzeRepository (analyzer.ts) reports each traced read as a confirmed finding; STRIPE_MOVE_REVIEW (stripe-field-moves.ts) appends the named Stripe reason where it has one. No rule edits the read, so a deterministic patch leaves it unresolved and the AI patch path (run.ts aiFindings, ai-patches.ts proposeAiPatch) receives it.
